classification: Unattended school/lab compute spend. NOT exploratory architecture design. Removes the 4v4-vs-6v6 foundation mismatch, then reuses the successful 4v4 split recipe at team size 6 with k=1 and the identical N' teacher. Does not guarantee a PASS; guarantees apples-to-apples chance.
PI_reading: Best-supported path to making 6v6 work like 4v4. Composition evidence (scripted 5A/1D, geometry CLOSEST_DEFENDS k=1) is optimistic. Repaired A/B must still learn something useful. Phrase as: gives 6v6 its best apples-to-apples chance of reproducing the 4v4 PASS; final crossover still has to be measured.

framing.method_unchanged: mature A/B specialists, frozen pi_A on ATTACK, pi_D warm-started from pi_A, 200k split PPO, same N' defender-teacher schedule, CLOSEST_DEFENDS, same Delta_A/Delta_B LCB95 gate
framing.scale_specific: N=6 networks/obs/actions; k=1 (5A/1D) from sealed 6v6 composition evidence — not a mechanical copy of 4v4 k=2
framing.wording: We preserve the same learning architecture across scales while using the role composition independently established for each team size.
framing.not: we designed 6v6 specifically so it can pass

attestation_block: t0 equivalence + frozen ATTACK never enters optimizer (pytest)

structure: mature repaired pi_A/pi_B -> freeze ATTACK pi_A -> pi_D from pi_A -> 200k PPO + same N' teacher as 4v4 -> CLOSEST_DEFENDS(k=1) -> sealed crossover gate

N_PRIME_TEACHER_LOCKED_identical_to_4v4.gate: DEFEND-role AND alive AND decision-eligible only
N_PRIME_TEACHER_LOCKED_identical_to_4v4.compatibility: GO_TO + waypoint N' stays inside 6v6 n_macros; same plumbing as 4v4 DEFEND_ATTACK_SPLIT_POLICY_A_V1.
N_PRIME_TEACHER_LOCKED_identical_to_4v4.DO_NOT: retune this schedule, cadence, or formula from 6v6 outcomes. Reuse exactly.
N_PRIME_TEACHER_LOCKED_identical_to_4v4.NOT_the_diagnostic: The 25k/50k CLOSEST_SPLIT viability run was teacher-free (defend_teacher_lambda=0) on the pre-entity base. That was a diagnostic. The school-PC paper split is NOT that setup.

EXPLICITLY_FORBIDDEN_on_school_PC: k=1 vs k=3 mixture as the paper system
pre-entity base as the split foundation
teacher-free split as the paper system (diagnostic only)
retuning the N' teacher lambda schedule, cadence, or formula based on 6v6 outcomes
spending confirmatory seeds before exploratory crossover PASS
restarting home c2 while school owns this chain

time_estimate_one_GPU.two_GPUs: run A and B in parallel -> foundation ~3 days

steps.name: verify/seal A final
steps.action: assert expected_finals.pi_A_repair exists; sha256sum; write SCHOOL_PC_6V6_PI_A_REPAIR_SEAL.json

steps.name: pi_B entity-repair 1M
steps.note: If two GPUs: start with step 1 in parallel on GPU1 / this on GPU2.

steps.name: verify/seal B final
steps.action: assert expected_finals.pi_B_repair exists; sha256sum; write SCHOOL_PC_6V6_PI_B_REPAIR_SEAL.json

steps.name: 200k split-defender PPO k=1 with N' teacher identical to 4v4 a4
steps.note: After A_repair exists, pin --split-attack-defend-frozen-ckpt-sha256 to the sealed A hash. Teacher schedule is locked: do not retune.

steps.name: freeze split final
steps.action: assert expected_finals.pi_D exists; sha256sum; write SCHOOL_PC_6V6_SPLIT_K1_SEAL.json

steps.name: exploratory crossover n=64
steps.gate: PASS iff Delta_A>0 and Delta_B>0 and both LCB95>0 (same 4v4 gate)

steps.name: confirmatory crossover n=128 IF exploratory PASS
steps.gate: same Delta_A/Delta_B LCB95; if PASS then 6v6=DONE

how_to_run_while_away.overall_bar_units: 1M (A) + 1M (B) + 200k (split) + 256 (eval cells) — ETA for the whole chain
how_to_run_while_away.per_stage_bars: each train/eval child writes its own PPO/eval tqdm to school_pc_6v6_<tag>.err

claim_boundary: If confirmatory PASS: 6v6 closed under the same measurement protocol as 4v4, including the same N' teacher schedule on the split. Foundation mismatch removed. Does not rewrite SDS observability or latent paper-faithful claims.
